SELECT 
  AVG(t.group_avg) as avg_group_avg,
  AVG(t.group_avg - o.overall_avg) as avg_diff_overall,
  AVG(t.group_avg - sa.status_group_avg) as avg_diff_status_group
FROM (
  SELECT m.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) as group_avg
  FROM scanmesh m
  JOIN sites s ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE m.facetfaces IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.zoneref, s.entrystat
) t
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM (
    SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) as group_avg
    FROM scanmesh m
    JOIN sites s ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    WHERE m.facetfaces IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.zoneref, s.entrystat
  )
) o
JOIN (
  SELECT entrystat, AVG(group_avg) as status_group_avg
  FROM (
    SELECT m.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) as group_avg
    FROM scanmesh m
    JOIN sites s ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    WHERE m.facetfaces IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.zoneref, s.entrystat
  ) t2
  GROUP BY entrystat
) sa ON t.entrystat = sa.entrystat
WHERE t.group_avg > sa.status_group_avg
